# 1.2.53 - the hammer on the map

Nothing here asks a world to be migrated.

- **Project tokens wear the hammer**, the same one the project's card shows when
  the token is opened, instead of Foundry's hazard sign. At its size under
  Isometric Perspective the hammer sits whole inside its floor frame. Project
  tokens already on a map, and the shared Project actor, move onto it the next
  time the GM loads the scene - unless a GM gave them an image of their own.
- **Loading a scene no longer rewrites every project token.** The sync compared
  the token's colour in a way that never matched, so each scene draw saved the
  tint of every project token again; it saves nothing when nothing changed.

275 regression tests pass on a live world.
